description: Files engine on Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2: an Entra ID client-credentials token from a custom authority host, a recursive path listing paged through the x-ms-continuation header, directories skipped, RFC 1123 times, reads capped by maxBytes (a JSON Lines file whose last line is cut is inferred from its complete lines, a JSON document that does not fit has no fields) and the directory's named ACL entries as grants.
